overview.description: Older adults face unique mental health challenges, such as depression and anxiety, with nearly 20% of adults aged 65 and older experiencing some form of mental health concern. Fortunately, online therapy has revolutionized mental health treatment, providing significant advantages over traditional in-person therapy. Finding the ideal online therapist is a personal journey. Total Life carefully pairs you with a remote counsellor who specializes in your specific concerns and aligns with your therapeutic preferences. If you don’t feel a connection with your initial therapist, don’t hesitate to try another. At Total Life, we prioritize finding the perfect match for you and offer easy switching options if needed. To be expertly matched with the best online therapists, call 1-800-567-5433 or sign up online.
